principles: 背景音乐服务叙事、理解和观看节奏，不用持续铺底制造虚假完成度。
先锁定人声、环境声和事实语气，再决定音乐进入、变化、退出或保持留白。
动态不等于频繁换歌；同一视频保持共同主题动机与音色家族，用编配、密度、和声、频段和留白形成变化。
事实、数据、限定条件、引用和不确定性不得被音乐渲染成更确定、更英雄化或更煽情。
所有转场优先落在语义边界与乐句边界，禁止在词中、数字中、否定关系中或自然呼吸中硬切。

frequencyStrategy.sub: high-pass musical material around 45-60 Hz unless the scene explicitly needs weight; never let sub energy mask room tone or plosives
frequencyStrategy.low: keep bass short, sparse and controlled around 70-180 Hz; avoid sustained low-mid bloom
frequencyStrategy.speechBand: leave a center pocket from roughly 180 Hz to 4 kHz, especially 1-3.5 kHz; move pads and melodic detail away from the narration formants
frequencyStrategy.high: soften persistent 6-10 kHz hats, shakers and air; no bright wash competing with consonants
frequencyStrategy.stereo: keep low frequencies mono, move texture and ambience to the sides, and preserve a stable center for dialogue

sidechain.rule: duck only enough to restore intelligibility; no audible pumping

negativePrompt: a dominant lead melody in the vocal range
boomy sub bass or muddy low mids
constant bright cymbal or hi-hat wash
trailer impacts, heroic swells or manipulative sentiment
corporate ukulele, stock-music cheerfulness or game-loop repetition
abrupt ending, unresolved tail or edit-hostile long reverb

tool-share.label: 工具分享
tool-share.style: precise modern editorial electronica with a human touch
tool-share.timbre: clean, tactile, dry, warm-neutral, quick transient recovery
tool-share.harmony: clear add9 and suspended voicings, low harmonic rhythm, restrained optimism
tool-share.groove: light forward pulse with space around instructions and clicks

book-talk.label: 解读好书
book-talk.style: sparse literary chamber ambience with editorial restraint
book-talk.timbre: intimate, woody, matte, slow-decaying, never sentimental
book-talk.harmony: open fifths, add2/add9 colors and unresolved but calm modal movement
book-talk.groove: mostly rubato or a barely perceptible pulse
avoid: music under dense reasoning or quotations

infinite-game.label: 有限的无限游戏
infinite-game.style: observational documentary score led by place, process and physical texture
infinite-game.timbre: organic, weathered, dimensional, natural transient detail
infinite-game.harmony: modal pedal tones with gradual color changes and no forced resolution
infinite-game.groove: movement derived from real action; environment sound remains primary

very-ai.label: 灰常AI
very-ai.style: playful but credible human-machine editorial electronica
very-ai.timbre: crisp, compact, witty, controlled, not gamer-like
very-ai.harmony: minor-add9 and suspended colors that can resolve cleanly at verified results
very-ai.groove: agile syncopation with deliberate comic stops and fact-check resets

hook.arrangement: start with one distinctive motif and a clean rhythmic question; reveal the full pulse only after the spoken hook
hook.harmonicMove: open or suspended, no oversized resolution

setup.arrangement: thin bed, one pulse and one texture, leave space for context

explanation.arrangement: remove lead elements and reduce note density; silence is preferred when speech is dense

process.arrangement: add a precise pulse tied to visible steps, with short transients and clear edit points

example.arrangement: introduce one concrete color instrument, then return to the shared motif
example.harmonicMove: brief color chord without changing the tonal identity

evidence.arrangement: prefer silence or a nearly static texture; no pulse competing with numbers, names, quotations or proof

fact_check.arrangement: intentional silence or room tone only

uncertainty.arrangement: intentional silence; do not imply certainty through harmony

contrast.arrangement: change register, rhythmic subdivision or timbre while preserving the motif; avoid trailer impacts
contrast.harmonicMove: controlled modal shift or borrowed chord

humor.arrangement: one dry setup gesture followed by a real pause at the punchline; never stack comic sounds

reflection.arrangement: remove percussion, widen ambience and let one organic voice breathe
reflection.harmonicMove: open voicing with slow color change

result.arrangement: restore pulse and one upper texture after the spoken result lands, not before

transition.arrangement: four- or eight-bar bridge with an obvious edit-safe tail

conclusion.arrangement: return to the opening motif in a simpler form and leave a clean tail
conclusion.harmonicMove: quiet partial resolution, no triumphal cadence
